text_block_list.text:
With the Asahi Hai FS approaching, 
Maruzensky spent her days enjoying her 
rigorous training regimen.

One day, Special Week and Grass Wonder, 
who were both chasing after Maruzensky's 
legacy, asked to run alongside her.

Taking those passionate feelings to 
heart... Maruzensky felt her motivation 
surge even higher heading into the Asahi 
Hai FS.
